prompt: One 7x7 status lamp — a hollow box, an empty frame — for the halted state (grey: stopped dead at zero condition). Authored from the master palette by art/tools/make-status-lamp.mjs. Seven shapes, one per LampState, because §16 lists colourblind-safe machine status as lamp SHAPE variation rather than colour alone — and the palette makes that urgent rather than optional, since starved amber and blocked red are deliberate neighbours on a warm limited palette and are near-identical under deuteranopia. Still ONE tint per state applied in code (§13), so the batch and the page are unchanged; the shape now carries the state and the colour reinforces it. The generator asserts every pair of shapes differs by at least six of twenty-five pixels, which is the greyscale criterion made mechanical. Core is `paper` so a multiply tint lands on the intended hue; the `ink` halo is what keeps a pale lamp legible on a pale machine. `trim` is false: all seven must sit on the same 7x7 grid or the lamp would jump around the machine as its state changed.
